description: Worked as a radio and television journalist after completing a commercial apprenticeship, before studying psychology.
Headed the day clinic of the Psychiatric Services Thun.

role: Co-Bereichsleiterin der psychiatrischen Ambulatorien (Co-head of psychiatric outpatient clinics)
description: Co-led the four psychiatric outpatient clinics of the Spital Region Oberaargau from December 2015 until her election to the city executive.

role: Mitglied des Stadtrats (Member of city parliament)
description: Member of the Bern city parliament (legislative) for the SP, first elected in November 2012 and re-elected in 2016.

role: Gemeinderätin / Direktorin für Tiefbau, Verkehr und Stadtgrün (City executive member / Director for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery)
description: Member of the Bern city executive heading the Department for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery (TVS).
First female mayor of Bern, heading the Präsidialdirektion. Took office on 1 January 2025 after being elected unopposed in the second round of the November 2024 election.

organization: Mieterinnen- und Mieterverband Kanton Bern (Tenants' Association of the Canton of Bern)
description: Served as president of the cantonal tenants' association in Bern.
